formal_statement: ∀ (L : Language Bool) (k : ℕ), L ∈ PEqualNP.Library.DTIME (fun n : ℕ => 2 ^ (n ^ k) + k) → ({s : List Bool | ∃ x : List Bool, x ∈ L ∧ s = List.replicate (2 ^ (x.length ^ k) + k) true ++ false :: x} : Language Bool) ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
plain_statement: If L is decided within 2^(n^k) + k steps then the language of the strings 1^(2^(|x|^k) + k) 0 x with x in L is in P. Standard padding argument (for example Arora and Barak, Computational Complexity, 2009, chapter 2 exercises); the padding is written in front so that the input is found after the first 0.
title: Upward padding: an exponential-time language, padded, is in P
